lines.trans: Hello, Chef.
Here is where you are hiding!
Ainura, is that you?
Do not make noise so loudly, please.
I looked for you everywhere for a long time.
Sit down next to me, want a drink with me?
Oh, Chef, I am at work after all!
I still need to wash the floors.
Drop the work, rest a little.
You are sitting alone in the dark.
It is quiet here and nobody bothers me.
But you cannot stay here.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

examples.text: Ой, это Илона! Я громко поставлю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's Ilona! I'll put it on speaker.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to make noise'.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Он всегда бросает вещи на пол.
examples.trans: He always throws things on the floor.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
examples.trans: Don't hang up, I'm begging you! I'm on my knees in front of you.

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to be in hiding
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hide (oneself)', paired with 'спрятаться'.

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: And the advance stays with us.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'darkness' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Nothing can be seen in the dark.

examples.text: Давай резко напугаем его в темноте!
examples.trans: Let us suddenly scare him in the dark!

examples.text: Ты что здесь делаешь в темноте?
examples.trans: What are you doing here in the dark?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'everywhere' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Vanya, the water! There's water everywhere!

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

related.gloss: intensified / related adverb (it is not allowed)

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: to one person you call ты; здравствуйте is the polite form; the first в is silent

examples.trans: All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
Why are you sitting in the corner?

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.
May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

examples.text: Пока ещё на мои деньги куплен! Встала и мыть посуду, шагом марш!
examples.trans: It's still bought with my money! Get up and wash the dishes, forward march!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.
We'll make it! The president always talks for a long time.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look for'.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.
A plot next to Grigory Soprykin.
Right nearby, round the corner, there's a cheburek café.

отдохнуть.gloss: to have a rest; to relax

examples.trans: You need to have a proper rest at home.

examples.text: Иди уже скорее домой, пора хорошенько отдохнуть.
examples.trans: Go home already quickly, it is time to have a good rest.

examples.text: Ложись спать, тебе надо хорошо отдохнуть.
examples.trans: Go to sleep, you need to rest well.
